properties.description: Handler-level: plan an epoch, arrive it, revise its description through plan_epoch, read the status back — must still be arrived (read `planned` before the fix). And the other direction: a new epoch lands planned; a revise of a still-planned epoch leaves it planned — which failed on the first draft of the fix (omitting status), because the core write replaces the property set; the fix carries the stored status forward. The epoch-touching suites (tools.rs, every_constructor_can_say_what_the_thing_is.rs, a_set_aside_decision_is_not_debt.rs) re-run green; clippy clean on both crates.
properties.findings: 2026-09-12: both pins green after the fix; the first was shown red before it; the second caught the first draft. Workspace suite run detached: 226 test binaries, 0 failures, rc=0. The 438 handler suite re-run with its sixth pin (a closed finding leaves its step): 6 of 6.
properties.name: Revising an epoch's prose keeps its status
